page.layout: One printed page of running text, left-hand side of the scan. Running head across the top (centred "LIBRI V.", right "De judiciis"), page number at top left. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature. The strip on the right is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: jorem autem numerum,ut fieri solet, tantùm ex-primi)deligat, ad quos provocare liceat Israëlitis, si quid minùs dextrè ab illis senioribus judicatum videretur,quosq́ue reliqui etiam ipsi synedrii mi-noris, vel subalterni judicii seniores in caufis dif-ficilibus & gravibus confulerent. Hos porrò se-ptuaginta ad oftium tabernaculi conventionis, quod extra populi castra, Exod.33.v.7, exstructū erat,educi è castris & congregari jubet, hac anne-xâ promissione, quòd ipse in nube descendere, cumque Mose colloqui vèlit,quid de septuaginta his fieri velit. Testatur insuper Deus,se de spiritu Mosis,hoc est,de sapientiæ,prudentiæ & fortitu-dinis donis,ad gubernationem necessariis, sume-re, hisq; impertiri velle, ut in gubernationis one-re ipsi adjumento, pariq; hîc in posterum cum i-pso ordine & loco sint.

Horum itaq; septuaginta tribunal summum, numeroque & dignitate amplissimum fuit, pri-mùm quidem in Siloh, tribus Ephraim; deinde Hierosolymis in tribu Juda, qui non sub regibus tantùm & ducibus residentes judicandi potesta-tem exercuerunt, verùm nullo etiam rege aut du-ce existente, eorum tamen duravit authoritas. Sub judicibus verò, quorum in summis tantùm populi angustiis extraordinaria fuit provincia,ut apud Romanos Dictatorum,ordinaria guberna-tio penes hoc synedrium fuit. Ac, ut Thalmudi-stæ tradunt,nemo judicabat tribum,sceptrum,pseudo-prophetam,aut sacerdotem magnum,nisi domus judicii, LXXII.judicum,nec egrediebatur ad bellum,nisi secü-dum os LXX.judicum,nec addebant civitati, nec salarius[?] templi,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "salarius" in the last line is hard to make out (possibly "salarius" with a different vowel); marked [?]. The first word "jorem" is a fragment, the end of a word broken at the top of the page, kept as printed. Printed as they stand: "primi)deligat" (a parenthesis after "primi"), "vèlit" and "exstructū" with the marks shown, "secü-dum" with the umlaut-like mark shown, and "Dictatorum,ordinaria" with no space after the comma. The italic passage is taken to run from "nemo" to "templi,"; "tradunt" appears roman.
